description: Local ebook library management via Calibre CLI tools (calibredb/ebook-meta/ebook-convert/ebook-polish) — no REST API, no content server required

novel_features.name: Health Score
novel_features.description: Computes a weighted 0-100 library health score from check_library output with per-category deductions for metadata completeness, format coverage, and integrity issues

novel_features.name: Duplicate Detection
novel_features.description: Finds duplicate books by title/author with exact, fuzzy, and broad matching modes — Calibre has no built-in duplicate detection

novel_features.name: Series Gap Detection
novel_features.description: Detects series with missing books by analyzing series_index gaps, reporting which volumes are absent

novel_features.name: Library Statistics
novel_features.description: Aggregate library statistics: format distribution, top authors, series breakdown, file sizes, and language counts

novel_features.name: Similar Books
novel_features.description: Content-based similar book finder using shared authors, tags, series, and publisher overlap with configurable similarity threshold

workflows.name: health-audit
workflows.description: Full library health audit with prioritized recommendations combining health-score and check_library output
